NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-17|payments]] verifies the payment on-chain and fires a webhook automatically. The product delivers before the buyer closes their wallet. The only question is whether you have assembled the stack correctly.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often exclude regions like Pakistan, hindering creators from selling digital products. COREMERCH offers a decentralized, blockchain-based solution that eliminates these restrictions. By using NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that you can reach a global audience without the limitations of conventional banking. This architecture empowers you to maintain full ownership of your data and product delivery.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital commerce stack, ensure you have your products ready and an understanding of the infrastructure components. You'll need a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic setup using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, and a payment processing system via NOWPayments. Familiarize yourself with file delivery options like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless product access.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Establish your payment and delivery pipeline by integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This platform allows you to accept USDT on Tron, which settles transactions in under 60 seconds for fees under $0.10. Pair this with a reliable file storage solution for your digital products. Once your payment system is linked, automate the delivery process, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly upon payment confirmation.
Cut through payment barriers with blockchain technology.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Test your payment processing by simulating a purchase with a small transaction. Monitor the automated delivery to confirm that customers receive their digital products without delays. This step is crucial for establishing a reliable customer experience. Once successful, you can officially launch your store, promoting it through social media and relevant channels.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing your digital store, focus on scaling your operations. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates for expanding your product offerings. Monitor your sales and customer feedback to optimize your marketing strategies. Explore different cryptocurrencies and payment methods to cater to an even broader audience. Implementing these strategies will help you grow sustainably without relying on external payment platforms.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Maintain total ownership of your digital products and data.

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Prepare your digital products and ensure they are ready for delivery. 2. Choose a hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Set up backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. 4. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. 5. Select a file storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Test your payment and delivery process before going live. 7. Promote your digital store to reach your target audience.
